resources.string: Hide connection recovery and app privacy
Restore only the screen reading connection for this app. Missing system permission is reported explicitly. Actions from the original task are never replayed.
System recovery permission is granted. The actual service connection still needs to be checked after recovery.
System recovery permission is missing. You can continue using the existing manual permission flow.
Set automation and your manual sharing permissions separately. Revoking access invalidates earlier observations during a run. The assistant cannot change these settings.
Mute apps opened by background tasks
Change only the audio mode of apps opened by the task, saving the original mode for restoration. System volume stays unchanged. Unrestored records remain if the system does not support restoration.
Restore clipboard from previous compatible input
Allow compatible paste in ordinary fields

Off by default. Used only in the current ordinary field of the original task. The original clipboard is encrypted, saved and restored; the assistant cannot read its contents. No paste occurs if Android denies reading the original value.
Current six-digit code shown by the system
This input window is valid for two minutes. After pairing, connect and verify the helper.
The input window has expired, the code is invalid, or the resource is in use. Return to phone settings and start again.
